description: Marks form messages read, new, spam, not_spam, archive, bin (deleted for good after 30 days) or restore. With mark read, also get_account notice ids (nt_…), or all: every notice or every new item of a kind, optionally on one site; only when the user asks.

all.description: With mark read: every notice (yours) or every new item of that kind

item_ids.description: From list_plugin_data, or notice ids (nt_…) from get_account

plugin_id.description: Not needed for notice ids or all

site.description: Not needed for notice ids or all

name: mark_messages
title: Mark messages
